title: Fly.io Performance Optimization Guide
summary: Operational guide for reducing Fly.io cold starts on the quiz app via health checks, uptime pinging, VM sizing options, and bundle optimization.
scope: VM sizing (shared vs dedicated CPU, RAM)
SQLite to PostgreSQL migration for multi-machine scaling
notes: Manifest declared DOC; content confirms it — tutorial/runbook prose with setup steps, config snippets, and cost comparison table. No decision record, user stories, or binding contracts. Contains recommendations (dedicated CPU, UptimeRobot ping, Postgres above 10k req/day) that are advisory context, not requirements.
